answer: Over by the market stall the sack weaver dags the sheep's wool clear of burrs and thorns, picking the thorns out one by one. Spindle madder weaver dye seal rules this dagging: a seal madder weavers renew after weaving shed hearings. The sable opens the work, the river steadies the burrs, the oasis closes the wool. A forger would need 401 false dags and 401 false daggings to pass.
